objects.taxonomy_description: Portable chair with collapsible frame. Frame is tubular steel (chrome-plated or painted) or molded plastic. Seat and back are flat panels (wood, plastic, or padded fabric) connected by hinge mechanism. Folded state: flat profile (5-8 cm thick) for storage. Open state: standard chair proportions (seat height 45 cm, back height 80 cm). Cross-brace X-frame provides stability. Seat surface is slightly contoured or flat. Color varies: black, white, beige, or patterned fabric. Hinge points are visible rivets or bolts. Weight is light (2-4 kg) for portability.

objects.taxonomy_description: Asian proboscidean measuring 250-300 cm at shoulder weighing 3000-5000 kg. Body massive with thick wrinkled gray-brown skin and sparse body hair. Head broad with twin-domed skull. Ears relatively small compared to African elephant. Trunk (proboscis) elongated and muscular with single finger-like projection at tip. Tusks present primarily in males, shorter than African species. Body barrel-shaped with arched back. Legs pillar-like with five toenails on forefeet. Tail long with terminal tuft. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy, sparse hair, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart.

diagnostic_checkpoints.Closure_Mechanism: A visible hinge runs along one edge connecting the base to a lid, indicating a clamshell opening method rather than a drawstring or zipper-only closure.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Carrying_Apparatus: A sturdy handle is attached to the top or side of the container, differentiating it from stationary storage boxes or chests.
